QuestInfo.0: #p2400005# discovered that #p2400006# held the corruption, but could not bring himself to tell her. But she herself was getting lost in memory...
QuestInfo.1: #p2400006# demanded a straight answer from #p2400005#, but she knew the answers she was looking for. She forced him into a heated battle...\r\n\r\n#r(Tip: Forfeit the quest if you need to restart.)#k
